Only the prune predicate was lifted (src-tauri/engine/src/webhook_ingest.rs:236), so a regression that strands or replays cloud firings stays green.

subjects.subject: agent-runtime-assembly
subjects.evidence: src-tauri/engine/src/cli_capabilities.rs:93 The CLI capability probe's own docs say two spawns can disagree because of the child session, but get_or_probe keeps one process-wide cache and only labels the replay served_from_cache.

subjects.subject: webhook-ingestion
subjects.evidence: src-tauri/src/commands/tools/triggers.rs:1745 replay still reads log_entry.body, which src-tauri/src/engine/webhook.rs:313 writes as the literal '[redacted: see encrypted persona_event payload]', so every replay re-signs and re-delivers the redaction marker and reports success (re-confirmed 2026-10-16, unfixed since 2026-09-23; line moved 304->313)

subjects.subject: agent-instruction-files
subjects.evidence: src-tauri/engine/src/cli_process.rs:1044 spawn_cwd launches design-analysis (src-tauri/src/commands/design/analysis.rs:353) and review (reviews.rs:2858) agent sessions in the Personas process cwd with no ancestry bound, so they inherit whatever instruction files sit above it (in dev, this repo's operator CLAUDE.md) and the loaded set is never asserted

subjects.subject: quality-gates
subjects.evidence: src-tauri/engine/src/recipe_eligibility.rs:234 a prompt_template that is not a JSON object is silently skipped and the recipe scores vacuously Eligible (pinned by the test at :477), and src-tauri/src/commands/recipes/recipe_adoption.rs:86 refuses adoption only on Incompatible - a gate that could not read its canonical signal waves the recipe through

subjects.subject: agent-memory
subjects.evidence: src-tauri/src/engine/memory_reflection.rs:876 team reflection sorts members' memories by importance/access_count/created_at and truncates at 200 (persona path :805 takes the 200 newest), a store-ordered cap with no per-item shortlist, so duplicates and contradictions in the low tail are never consolidation candidates

subjects.subject: supply-chain
subjects.evidence: src-tauri/src/engine/tool_runner.rs:567 every script tool runs 'npx tsx <script>' with no version, so tsx is resolved (and on a machine without it, fetched from the registry) at run time outside any lockfile or policy gate - an unpinned dependency executing persona tool code

subjects.subject: agent-cli-transport
subjects.evidence: src-tauri/engine/src/cli_process.rs:45-49 force_subscription_auth (the one spawn door every path in this file calls) strips only ANTHROPIC_*; CLAUDECODE/CLAUDE_CODE session-marker stripping is duplicated instead of centralized (inline in prompt/cli_args.rs:204-205, a separate nesting_env_removals() in companion/session/launch.rs:458) — a new CliArgs-building call site must remember the strip itself, the forgettable-guard shape subscription-auth-selection's session-nesting clause warns against. (cli_capabilities.rs's probe() is a strong, independent realization of availability-probe/dated-capability-matrix in the same file set.)

subjects.subject: rate-limiting
subjects.evidence: src-tauri/src/engine/webhook.rs:499 refuses 429 with no_headers() (retry-after only in body prose; same at the auth-fail 429 :365) although the same file sets Retry-After on its active-window path at src-tauri/src/engine/webhook.rs:521 - header-honouring senders get nothing and guess (anchors re-read 2026-11-03; cited files unchanged since 2026-10-21, subject digest unchanged at revision 8)

subjects.subject: docs-sync
subjects.evidence: src-tauri/src/commands/infrastructure/doc_rot.rs:661 The rot scan consumes the doc map only as document keys and never counts source files that match no entry, so an unmapped share of a tree cannot fail this scan.

subjects.subject: codebase-scanning
subjects.evidence: src-tauri/src/commands/infrastructure/static_scan.rs:127 tool output is parsed without checking output.status, and parse_fallow maps malformed JSON to Value::Null (:564), so a crashed or misconfigured tool records a complete scan with zero findings (re-verified, still live)

subjects.subject: agent-instruction-files
subjects.evidence: src-tauri/src/commands/infrastructure/context_map_export.rs:370 splice requires both markers else appends a second block; a CLAUDE.md holding a START without its END gets a duplicate START, and the next scan replaces everything from the orphan START to the new END, deleting hand-written lines outside the fence

subjects.subject: agent-cli-transport
subjects.evidence: src-tauri/src/commands/infrastructure/standards_scan.rs:314 run_standards_scan builds its own spawn from headless_claude_args instead of going through the spawn_headless_claude door, and never calls force_subscription_auth. A metered Anthropic key in the app env therefore bills every standards scan, and the scan runs with skip-permissions in the project root: a scanner with an editor's stance.

subjects.subject: supply-chain
subjects.evidence: src-tauri/src/commands/infrastructure/setup.rs:486 the Node MSI fetched from nodejs.org (:450) is executed by msiexec with no digest check against the published SHASUMS256, and :675 pipes curl into sudo bash; a substituted or tampered installer runs with installer privileges

subjects.subject: standards-layered-runtime
subjects.evidence: src-tauri/src/commands/infrastructure/standards_scan.rs:314 The governance scans start an external headless Claude CLI process inside a repo and parse what it prints. The 'standards' here means a code ruleset, not web-platform standards. A search of src-tauri/src found no boa_engine, rquickjs, deno_core, register_global or guest_context, so this code embeds no guest runtime.
